recognize_zh: 流式細胞圖中 CD19 陽性 B 細胞族群（藍色）CD20 高亮、CD5 陰性、CD38 陰性、lambda 輕鏈限制，並共同表現 CD25、CD103 與 CD11c（箭頭處），這組抗原組合是毛狀細胞白血病（HCL）的免疫表型。
features: Dominant CD19+ B-cell population (blue) gated in the lymphocyte region with bright CD45
Bright CD20 expression (arrowhead) compared with background cells
Lambda light-chain restriction with absent kappa expression
Co-expression of CD25, CD103 and bright CD11c by the B-cell population (arrows)
Surface CD3-negative B cells separated from residual T cells (red)
describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the lymphocyte gate shows a predominant clonal B-cell population that is CD19-positive, bright CD20-positive and CD45 bright. The B cells are negative for CD5 and CD38 and demonstrate lambda light-chain restriction. They co-express CD25, CD103 and bright CD11c, while residual T cells are separated by surface CD3 expression. This immunophenotype (CD11c+, CD25+, CD103+, bright CD20, lambda restricted) is diagnostic of a clonal B-cell population consistent with hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: HCL-v is CD11c+ and often CD103+ but CD25-negative (and CD123/CD200 dim), unlike this CD25-positive population.
SMZL B cells are usually CD103-negative and CD25-negative or weak, with CD11c at most partial.
CLL is CD5+, CD23+ with dim CD20 and dim light chain, unlike the CD5-negative, bright CD20 population here.
MCL is CD5-positive and CD103/CD25-negative, with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression.
